purpose: Measure how much natural FAR/MIDDLE/RECENT output variation is explained by native FrameSamp retention differences versus residual variation after exact evidence matching.

prerequisite.replication_a_result: Temporal positional representation causally affects the initial inferred 16x8 action chunk under fixed retained content/order, with strong process-block robustness.

matched_arm.frame_selection: exact index override on the full natural history
matched_arm.temporal_positions: native source/global temporal positions for each condition
matched_arm.note: This matched set is frozen before inspecting any Question B outputs and reuses the Replication A evidence-selection rule.

primary_analysis.primary_metric: MAE on initial inferred 16x8 action chunk
primary_analysis.natural_difference: pairwise output difference under native FrameSamp
primary_analysis.matched_difference: same pairwise output difference after exact retained-evidence matching

retention_diagnostics: exact retained identities and global positions

interpretation_rules.matched_much_smaller_than_natural: retention differences explain a substantial part of the natural condition effect
interpretation_rules.matched_remains_substantial: retention matching is insufficient; residual order/temporal-representation/utilization effects remain
interpretation_rules.replication_a_role: Replication A may help explain the temporal-representation component of a residual, but does not establish that it is the sole mechanism
interpretation_rules.behavior_claims: No behavioral-success claim is permitted from Question B open-loop action chunks alone.

process_plan.reason: Replication A established very small fresh-process nuisance variation; Question B instead uses exact within-run replay/invariants.

hard_stop: Any provenance, selection, replay, cache, shape, or evidence-matching invariant failure aborts the run.
